Get LBA Play-by-Play

Source: R/lba.R
lba_pbp.Rd

Play-by-play of a final game (2017-18 on), one row per action with x/y; coordinate frame by era.

Endpoint: GET https://www.legabasket.it/api/championships/get-championships-matches-play-by-play (info=true&sort=asc&id=<game_id>)

Usage

lba_pbp(game_id)

Arguments

game_id

(required) Game id (game_id in lba_calendar), e.g. 25602. Global across seasons.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Play-by-play of a final game (2017-18 on), one row per action with x/y; coordinate frame by era. The columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py lba_pbp); a column the site adds later is appended after them:

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerGame id (global across seasons); joins lba_calendar and lba_game.
seasonintegerSeason END year (2027 = 2026-27): the row's START year + 1.
home_team_idintegerHome team-season id of the game (the play-by-play ht_id).
visitor_team_idintegerVisitor team-season id of the game (the play-by-play vt_id).
team_sidecharacterSide of the acting team, home or visitor; null for a clock action without a team.
home_scoreintegerHome points after the action, parsed from the score text (2021-22 on; else null).
visitor_scoreintegerVisitor points after the action, parsed from the score text (2021-22 on; else null).
coord_framecharacterFrame of x and y: half_court_px (2017-18 and 2018-19 image pixels) or court_pct (2019-20 on, 0-100).
action_idintegerAction id within the game (ascending in time from 2021-22; not ordered before).
descriptioncharacterAction type in Italian, e.g. 2 punti segnato (2-pointer made); full translation table in the Divergence notes.
player_idintegerPlayer id (null for team and clock actions).
team_idintegerTeam id (team-season) of the actor.
home_clubinteger1 = the home team acted, 0 = the away team; null for clock actions, and on every action in 2018-19 and 2019-20 (use side there).
in_arealogicalTrue on shots from the paint (zone 3).
dunkinteger1 = dunk, 0 otherwise.
secondsintegerElapsed seconds within minute (0-59); 0 before 2019-20. Elapsed = minute x 60 + seconds; print_time = period length minus that.
minuteintegerElapsed minute of the period (2019-20 on: 0-9, with seconds); 2017-18 / 2018-19: 1-10, the minute in progress, seconds 0.
periodintegerPeriod: 1-4, 5+ = overtime.
orderintegerSort key; sort=asc orders by it.
sideintegerBasket the row's side_area_zone is measured from, as sent: 0 = the basket at x = 0, 1 = the one at x = 100 (zone A is that basket's half: x < 50 for 0, x >= 50 for 1). It is NOT the team of the game (that is team_side): on shots, assists, fouls committed, turnovers and offensive rebounds it is the actor's attacking basket, which changes at half-time; on defensive rebounds, steals, blocks and fouls drawn it is the opponent's.
xintegerCourt x; frame by era (see the coordinates section): 2019-20 on, 0-100 % of the 28 m length; 2017-18 / 2018-19, half-court image pixels; null (2019-20 on) or 0 (earlier) when unlocated.
yintegerCourt y; 2019-20 on, 0-100 % of the 15 m width; 2017-18 / 2018-19, image pixels (see the coordinates section).
scorecharacterScore after the action, home - away string (0 - 0); 2020-21 on scoring actions only, null before.
linked_action_idintegeraction_id of the related action: the shot an assist or rebound belongs to, the foul a drawn foul answers, the player swapped in a substitution.
print_timecharacterGame clock remaining, MM:SS (10:00 at a period start); null before 2021-22.
action_1_qualifier_codecharacterFirst qualifier code, number sent as a string (shot type, turnover type, foul type; see legend).
action_2_qualifier_codecharacterSecond qualifier code (fast break 500, blocked 1005, tip-ins 1001-1004, ...).
action_1_qualifier_descriptioncharacterlegend label of action_1_qualifier_code, Italian.
action_2_qualifier_descriptioncharacterlegend label of action_2_qualifier_code, Italian.
side_area_zonecharacterA = in the actor's attacking half, D = its defensive half (2021-22 on).
side_area_codecharacterCourt zone 1-10, number sent as a string (see the coordinates section; 2021-22 on).
player_namecharacterGiven name of the acting player.
player_surnamecharacterFamily name of the acting player.
player_numbercharacterJersey number, number sent as a string.
team_namecharacterTeam name in that season, with its sponsor (Nutribullet Treviso Basket); changes with the sponsor.
idintegerAlways null (not a key).

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these wrappers read the JSON API that the Next.js site www.legabasket.it itself calls. Legal notice: the site's terms say "Non e' consentito copiare ... dati e informazioni senza autorizzazione scritta" (copying data and information without written authorisation is not allowed), except for personal, non-commercial use. The owner accepted the restriction for this intake on 2026-10-12. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets, and any published data release of this source needs separate sign-off.

  • robots.txt allows /api and sets Crawl-delay: 2. The runtime waits 2 s before every request, retries included. Crawl incrementally: fetch a final game once (keyed by game_id), find new games with one lba_calendar call per round, and do not backfill a history in a burst.

  • Seasons are END years (2027 = 2026-27); the site sends START years and the runtime maps them (season - 1 on the wire). Game and player ids are global; team ids are re-issued every season (join lba_teams for the stable club_id); a championship id is one season AND one phase (Regular Season and Play Off differ).

  • Play-by-play starts in 2017-18 and changes shape in 2019-20 (pixel frame to court percent) and 2021-22; see lba_pbp. Box scores reach back to 1995-96, where the period scores were not recorded (0 means missing).

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, or a body with no rows: an unknown season, a play-by-play before 2017-18, standings of a finished championship without a round), hoopR_bad_request (a season that is not an END year, a bad choice, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other non-2xx, a connection failure after retries, an empty / non-JSON / error-shaped 200, a game that is not final on the box score, play-by-play and shot routes, a truncated page, or a body for another season, championship, game, team, player, round or category than the one asked for). An unknown id is HTTP 500, which is not retried. A body the parser finds no rows in gives a zero-row tibble with these columns.
